verdict.rationale: Merchants can shape risk decisions with their own data through custom risk rules built around their unique fraud risks (docs-6), risk lists based on 'your own data' (docs-7), and the Referrals API for uploading block/trust lists (docs-13). Device data is gathered through Adyen's own data collection SDK (docs-15). However, the ML scoring is described as running on Adyen's global transaction data (docs-5, docs-20), and nothing shows you can feed your own signals into the model itself. missing for 10: ability to submit custom metadata or behavioral signals as model features, ingestion of merchant-supplied device fingerprints, documentation on how merchant data affects the ML score, independent corroboration.
